title: 有馬記念の後に・白星

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O is the victor in her duel with Mr. C.B.!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, it seems their battle has only just begun. The two racers banter over who will win their next race, already looking to their futures.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Symboli Rudolf and Maruzensky watch over the pair of excited racers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of them can't wait to see the day when Sakura Chiyono O shocks and awes the world with her speed.
